name: OwnerLock
short: Choose which cog commands only bot owners may use, across all servers.
description: Global owner-only command gate for selected Red cogs. Use [p]olock protect <CogName> to restrict every command and subcommand of a loaded cog to Red bot owners in all guilds and DMs. Persists policies through reloads and offers inspect/list commands. OwnerLock detects and warns about listener-based cogs, whose automatic event handlers and background tasks require separate enforcement.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Only a globally shared list of protected cog names is stored; no user IDs, guild IDs, user messages, or user-generated content are persisted.
install_msg: Use [p]load ownerlock and then [p]olock cogs or [p]olock protect CogName. Only Red bot owners can manage the lock. Event listeners/background tasks inside other cogs are not generically blocked.
